mapper.select: SELECT A.SEQNO seqno, A.SEC_TYPE_MODEL secTypeModel, A.SEC_DETAIL_TYPE_MODEL secDetailTypeModel, A.FINPROD_ID finprodId, A.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, A.GRADE_SOURCE gradeSource, A.GRADE_RESULT gradeResult, A.BASEDATE basedate, A.SPREAD spread, A.SPREAD_ADJ spreadAdj, A.B_FULLPRICE bFullprice, A.B_QTY bQty, A.MOD_METHOD modMethod FROM MOD_RISK_PREMIUM A WHERE A.SEQNO = #{seqNo}

SELECT A.FINPROD_ID id,A.FINPROD_ABBR text FROM FIN_PRODUCT A INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE B ON A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID WHERE A.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN ('F01','F18') AND B.TYPE_11 NOT IN ('011','013','023') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM FIN_PRODUCT C WHERE C.IS_SUS = 'Y' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN D WHERE C.FINPROD_ID = D.FINPROD_ID AND EXERCISE_TYPE = '01' ) AND C.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID )
and (A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') or A.FINPROD_ABBR like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%'))
